title: Bar Scene Collage
coreRelationships: The central collage is the primary focal point, contrasting in color and detail with the background.
The four photographic panels within the collage are arranged in a 2x2 grid, each depicting different groups of people in a bar.
The illustrative filter applied to the photographs unifies their style and creates a slightly dreamlike or aged quality.
The distressed text element is subtly integrated into the background, providing context without dominating the image.
reuseFormula: Generate a dark red, subtly textured background. Center a slightly off-white, soft-edged rectangular collage on it. Populate the collage with four distinct, illustratively filtered, and faded bar scenes. Overlay distressed, light-colored, loosely tracked sans-serif text in title case above the collage.
